entries.text: Hey, now we're talking. Hey. Right here, man, right here! Hey, come on! Stop, you son of a... You know, you got, like, highway hypnosis or something. You didn't see me standing there, yelling, waving? You better watch that.

entries.text: Utah? What are you doing there?

entries.text: The, uh, local coroner wants a consultation on a murder victim.... A man who was found beaten to death in the desert. Apparently, his corpse shows some anomalous characteristics.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: From what they're telling me, he is a 22-year-old backpacker who was last seen by his family about six months ago in perfect health. However, his body is now showing advanced signs of osteoporosis arthritis and kyphosis of the vertebrae. In other words, he's got a spine of a 90-year-old woman.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Sounds anomalous, all right. You didn't need me to tag along?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Well, if there's anything I can do from here.

entries.text: Well, actually, there might be, if you don't mind. Somewhere in our files... There is a, uh, an unsolved murder case. entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Yeah, mucous... But it was, uh, unable to be identified, and seeing as how you, uh, recently read through all of our files I thought maybe it would ring a bell with you.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Well, I don't have a great memory for mucous... But I'll be happy to look. Remember anything else? Agent Scully? Agent Scully?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: No, no, just, uh, just mucous. Look, when you find that file, will you fax it over to the juab county sheriff's office? That's the best place to reach me. My cell phone doesn't seem to be working out here.

entries.text: Um... They, uh... Take good care of me.

entries.text: Yeah, I'd say they take very good care of you. The sun seems to rise and set on you as far as they're concerned. In fact, they seem to have stranded me here in order to nurse you back to health.

entries.text: A murder took place about 20 Miles from here. A man was stoned to death. His head was so badly crushed that they couldn't identify him from his teeth. entries.text: I don't know how far this extends or how to get it out of you without harming you.

entries.text: You will die if we cannot treat you properly. Now, these people don't seem to want to let you go. I think that they put this thing inside of you.
